split_unit: Complete source CycleIndex; v1 opened cells are used development evidence. Fresh cells permit their own declared calibration, not zero-shot inference.
intended_case: LG M50T NMC P7/P17/P19/P13, 1s4p same-side ladder, nominal 1 mOhm per segment on each rail; 14.55 A discharge for 360 s after rest, starting SOC proxies 0.3 to 0.8, nominal 23 C ambient. Physical lead/contact values and initial states require confirmation.
budget_note: Proposed research decision budget, not an established safety/manufacturer/application requirement: model 25 mV, instrumentation/reference 10 mV, initialization 10 mV, temperature transfer 5 mV; sum 50 mV. Last three allocations are unverified, so threshold classification is diagnostic only.
baseline: v1 functional form: loaded C/20 curve plus piecewise-linear calibration late-rest corrections, constant R0 fitted on HPPC only. On all v2 cells use only allowed calibration cycles. Keep actual sealed-v1 predictions separately for diagnosis.
reference: Monotone PCHIP through calibration cycles' last 30 s of step 11, plus cycle-1 initial step-9 last 30 s. Reject nonmonotonic anchors. No held voltage or end-value extrapolation; outside anchor domain return unsupported.
fit_coverage: All step10..22 samples in calibration cycles, including 4.85 A x 360 s discharge, long rest, HPPC, multisine and final rest. Each cycle/phase gets equal weight; time-quadrature weights within each phase. Phases: step10, step11, steps12..15, steps17..22.
dynamics: C1 constant R0; C2 constant R0/R1/tau; C3 piecewise-linear positive R0 and R1 at SOC .1/.5/.9 with one shared tau. Exact interval recurrence under left-held input; state zero at cycle start after preceding rest, never initialized from held voltage.
selection: Macro-average each development cell's primary-domain sample and time RMSE. Candidate must improve both by at least 20% against protocol-matched baseline, not increase maximum error, have interior positive parameters and (RC) 5%-SSE tau support excluding search endpoints and normalized sensitivity condition <1000 in every development cell. Choose simplest eligible model within 10% of best combined sample/time RMSE. If none eligible retain baseline. Acceptance is evaluated separately, not guaranteed by selection.
stability: Leave one calibration cycle out of dynamic-parameter fit, fixed reference anchors; report parameter ranges, profiles, sensitivity condition. Not a metrological confidence interval. Sensitivity: +/-0.02 initial SOC at prediction, +/-1% capacity, right-held current, alternate loaded/rest reference and +/-5 mV initial polarization.
evaluation_policy: Freeze plan/input lock before any candidate fitting; freeze executable procedure and selected model before accessing fresh calibration voltage; seal fresh calibrated parameters before fresh assessment voltage is scored. No post-assessment tuning. Additional characterized cells on same rig are not independent module validation.
